facts.fact: A checklist for a new hire's first week in the customer support team.
The team leads who do the onboarding. They tick it off day by day.
Three new hires start on {{today+21d}}; the checklist is needed before then.
One page, grouped by day, Monday to Friday.
Day 1: laptop and accounts. Days 2 and 3: shadowing a senior agent. Day 4: first own tickets, with review. Day 5: feedback talk with the team lead.
Contracts and payroll paperwork are handled by HR and do not belong in the checklist.
